understanding: The task is to refine an existing object detection system based on user feedback. It requires three concrete actions: 1) Change the default model in configs/live-webcam.yaml from a hardcoded 'yolo11x' to 'yolo11m' while keeping it configurable. 2) Add a conf_threshold parameter (default 0.4) to DetectorConfig and enforce it in UltralyticsDetector. 3) Run a one-time demo using 'yolo11x' on device 0 (real camera), save the result as runs/webcam-proof-v2.png, and provide a detection log. The goal is to deliver a balanced default configuration and a proof image showing high-quality recognition.
summary: Modify configs/live-webcam.yaml to set yolo11m as default. Add conf_threshold=0.4 to DetectorConfig and apply it in UltralyticsDetector. Execute a single demo run with yolo11x on device 0, saving runs/webcam-proof-v2.png and logging detections with class and confidence.

decision_atoms.statement: Set default model to yolo11m in configs/live-webcam.yaml
decision_atoms.reason: yolo11m provides a balance between FPS and accuracy for continuous camera feeds, as specified in the known context.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Slightly lower accuracy compared to yolo11x, but significantly better inference speed for live video.

decision_atoms.statement: Add conf_threshold parameter with default 0.4 to DetectorConfig
decision_atoms.reason: User feedback requires a confidence threshold to filter low-confidence detections, improving result quality.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: May miss some true positives with confidence below 0.4, but reduces false positives and noise.

decision_atoms.statement: Apply conf_threshold from DetectorConfig in UltralyticsDetector
decision_atoms.reason: The threshold must be enforced during inference to have any effect on detection output.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds a small amount of logic to the detection pipeline, but is a standard filtering step.

decision_atoms.statement: Run demo once with yolo11x on device 0 and save proof image
decision_atoms.reason: Task explicitly requires a single demo run to show the user the quality ceiling of yolo11x.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Uses the heavier model once, which may be slow, but demonstrates maximum accuracy potential.

assumptions: The existing codebase has a DetectorConfig class/dataclass that can be extended with a conf_threshold field.
UltralyticsDetector already reads configuration from DetectorConfig and can be modified to pass conf_threshold to the model's inference call.
A real camera is available on device 0 and accessible by the system.
The yolo11x model weights are available or can be downloaded automatically by the ultralytics library.
The directory 'runs/' exists or can be created by the script.

risks.risk: Camera device 0 is not available or fails to capture a frame.
risks.mitigation: Add a fallback to use a sample image or video file if the camera is inaccessible, and log a warning.

risks.risk: yolo11x model download fails due to network issues.
risks.mitigation: Ensure the environment has internet access; if offline, pre-download the model weights.

risks.risk: conf_threshold change breaks existing tests or pipelines that expect no threshold filtering.
risks.mitigation: Make the threshold configurable and default to 0.4; existing configs without the field can default to 0.0 for backward compatibility.

minimal_version: Update configs/live-webcam.yaml: default model yolo11m. Add conf_threshold=0.4 to DetectorConfig. Modify UltralyticsDetector to filter results by conf_threshold. Run demo script: load yolo11x, capture from device 0, save runs/webcam-proof-v2.png, print detection log.
advanced_version: In addition to minimal: add CLI argument to override conf_threshold at runtime, log detections to a structured JSON file alongside the image, and include a small test to verify that the default model is yolo11m and conf_threshold is applied correctly.
